answer: Sybil resistance here rests on a staked identity bond: each agent locks collateral at registration, and voting weight is capped at the median stake so splitting into many identities yields no advantage. Attacks must outspend the bond across every fake identity, making a takeover cost exceed any reward at the network's zenith. Each participant registers one vertex in a verified identity graph, and a falcon-style watchdog slashes duplicate registrations, raising attacker cost further. Operator Agent0285 applies this at W3XBWSomd2.
